To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a combined smartwatch use and social media-delivered intervention was feasible, of interest, and demonstrated initial effectiveness in improving health behaviors/outcome among college students.
both the experimental and comparison interventions were feasible and demonstrated initial effectiveness on college students’ PA, dietary, and psychosocial health behaviors/outcomes.

the combined smartwatch and social media-delivered, theory-based, health education intervention was feasible and demonstrated initial effectiveness in improving college students’ PA, physiological, psychosocial and dietary behaviors/outcomes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing and evaluating a novel health education intervention to improve college students’ PA and dietary behaviors.
the use of wearable technology and social media in improving PA and dietary behaviors among college students.
the development and testing of a theoretically-based social media-delivered intervention to improve PA, dietary behaviors, and other health outcomes among college students.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this intervention is a promising approach to improving health behaviors/outcome of interest to college students.
the use of smartwatches and social media to improve physical activity and dietary behaviors among college students is feasible and has potential to be an effective intervention.
a social media-delivered intervention may be an effective tool to help improve health behaviors/outcomes among college students.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
both interventions were feasible and effective at increasing physical activity, improving physiological/psychosical health, and decreasing caloric consumption among college students.

a combination of a smartwatch with social media-delivered, theory-based health education intervention is feasible, acceptable, and may be an effective strategy to improve college students’ health behavior and outcomes.
both interventions were acceptable to college students and showed initial promise at promoting positive health behaviors and outcomes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
social media can be used to deliver effective health behavior interventions to college students.
the use of smartwatch technology and social media-delivered education is an effective way to improve health behaviors among college students.
the use of wearable devices and social media to deliver health education may provide a novel, effective, and feasible means to improve health behaviors/outcomes among young adults.
